title: Brazilian Port Calls & Lead Time 2023-2025
subtitle: Brazilian port-call data for lead-time and machine learning
description: Academic snapshot of cleaned Brazilian port-call records for EDA, regression, quantile regression, and supply chain lead-time studies. Manual port coordinates and municipality fields are excluded from the public Kaggle outputs; attribution is required for Porto Sem Papel / Ministerio de Portos e Aeroportos and Open-Meteo.
userSpecifiedSources:
Sources and transformations:
- Estadia das Embarcações no Porto Sem Papel, Ministerio de Portos e Aeroportos / Porto Sem Papel: https://dados.transportes.gov.br/dataset/estadia-embarcacao. Port-call data were cleaned and transformed into one consolidated vessel call per row.
- Portos no Porto Sem Papel - PSP, Ministerio de Portos e Aeroportos / Porto Sem Papel: https://dados.transportes.gov.br/dataset/portos-psp. State/UF was reconstructed by exact public port-code matching where available; region was derived from state.
- Open-Meteo historical weather: https://open-meteo.com/. Lagged weather values are derived from Open-Meteo historical weather data.
Manually researched municipality and coordinate fields from the academic workflow are not redistributed in the public Kaggle files.

resources.description: Dataset landing-page documentation describing the port-stay prediction problem, files, target, splits, leakage policy, limitations, citation, and attribution.
Source provenance and licensing review for the public dataset, including Porto Sem Papel, the official PSP port reference, and Open-Meteo.
CSV analytical dataset for EDA and descriptive research. It contains 95 columns, including variables that are not necessarily valid arrival-time predictors.
